audience: Office workers 28-45 looking for a lighter alternative to energy drinks

products.name: Tidewell Citrus Electrolyte
products.prompt:
Commercial advertising photograph of Tidewell Citrus Electrolyte: matte sun-yellow sports bottle of citrus electrolyte drink. Scene: bright modern office desk by a window, laptop softly out of focus. Made for a social campaign aimed at Office workers 28-45 looking for a lighter alternative to energy drinks in United States & Germany. Art direction: bright natural daylight, warm summery palette with teal and sun-yellow accents, crisp condensation on cold drinks, shallow depth of field, premium but approachable lifestyle photography
. Composition: the product is the clear hero, centered, fully in frame, with generous empty background around it so the image can be reframed and have copy placed over the lower third. No text, letters, numbers, logos, labels with words, or watermarks anywhere in the image.
